question: True or false: tuning GPT-4 into a chat assistant made its confidence a worse guide to whether it was right?
answer: True. On a multiple-choice test, OpenAI found the raw pre-trained model well calibrated: how sure it was matched how often it was right. After training it into a helpful assistant, the two matched far less well, as OpenAI's own chart shows. The assistant people talk to knows less about its own reliability.
move: Improving how something performs can damage how well it knows itself.
ask: Where has getting better at performing made me worse at knowing what I do not know?
trap: Assuming the tuning that makes answers better improves every measure.
